response.overview: In the impoverished capital of Madagascar, an amateur assassin with diabetes runs out of insulin on the long-awaited day of his first hit. Confined to his apartment with under 24 hours before his body shuts down, he must carry out the mission while concealing his worsening condition from a constant stream of people barging into his life.
response.tagline: For a diabetic assassin, this is the last shot.
response.title: Insulation
